en: Vintage-style postcard with a sepia background showing an old advertisement for a three-wheeled bicycle (tricycle). The illustration depicts a man riding a large-front-wheel tricycle with two children seated together on a double seat above the rear axle. The card is filled with German text promoting the product, headed by the name of a sewing-machine factory in Saalfeld (Saale, Thüringen) and the model name 'Antilope A.' The layout and typography imitate an 1890s advertisement.
